main_body: A wooden counter or shelf unit (rows 6-17) with three dark inset openings holding goods (an orange item at right). The strips at rows 0-4 and 19-24 are separate wood bands or neighbouring pieces.
top_band: No clear top band. The body starts at row 6 with a 1-2 row dark brown/tan cap, and grey sill highlights at rows 7-8 sit above the openings. The wood bands at rows 0-4 and 19-24 are detached from the body.
evidence: Reading a column through the middle of the body, a thin cap of 1-2 rows leads straight into the vertical face (shelf openings and a lower panel) with no foreshortened horizontal surface. The shelf openings are inset, but the top is only a rim, so this is a front elevation with a hat. In the guide it matches the red 'front elevation: top 1' and 'rim only' cases, not the green cabinet.

style.evidence: The wood has about five steps (tan highlight, orange, mid brown, dark brown, deep brown) with grain dots and plank variation. Outlines are dark brown, tinted to match the wood, not black. No large flat fills. It is slightly thinner than the roofed stall and well references, but acceptable next to them.
